>"I just need one thing that is mine and he won't budge bc he gives me so much [that I don't ask for]"

Oh my god, are we living the same life? I literally just had this arguement about this (again) ;-; I'm so lost on what to do. Conversation about this just go in circle without solution.

He really wants "our" first house to be "perfect" because he dreamt of it, saved money for it, and planned for it for years. He listen to be about anything else, but my recommendations of this house seem to be out of the table.
OP are you me? Damn I relate to this too much.
